label: Figure 11.12: Productive and allocative efficiency in the long run in perfect competition
alt: In long-run equilibrium the profit-maximising output q, the productively efficient output q1 (MC = AC) and the allocatively efficient output q2 (MC = AR) are all the same output.
caption: The price line is tangent to the minimum of AC, so a single output satisfies all three conditions: q (MC = MR), q<sub>1</sub> (MC = AC, productive efficiency) and q<sub>2</sub> (MC = AR, allocative efficiency). The firm earns normal profit only.
